rule: FR-322-AC-148..FR-322-AC-150; a clock_place is one template node for each clock path; the slot selector is a reference to the type node of the selector domain (Integer for Sequence, Set, Bag and OrderedSet, the key type for Map); a concrete position or key exists only on an instantiated place and enters no node
node_key: sha256 over the RFC 8785 bytes of {version, node_tag, semantic_form, semantic_type: null (self-typed), declaration: null, recursion: null, body}
